title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: the amount applied from a remittance that covers the charges due
content:
## Rule
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product a remittance that covers the charges due is applied at exactly the charges due, and finance returns the excess, which is never booked. When the charges due are 0.00 or less, nothing is applied. For an acceptance whose holder is not the booking party, the amount applied is 0.00. The amount applied is stated to two decimal places.

## Truth table
| Charges due | Holder is the booking party | Amount applied |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00 or less | any | 0.00 — nothing is applied |
| above 0.00 | no | 0.00 |
| above 0.00 | yes | exactly the charges due |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)
| Charges due | Remittance quoted | Amount applied | Excess returned by finance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 353.40 | 400.00 | 353.40 | 46.60, not booked |
| 353.40 | 353.40 | 353.40 | none |
| 0.00 | 250.00 | nothing applied | — |

## Wrong reading and correct basis
- *Wrong*: "Apply the full 400.00 and leave the account in credit." *Correct*: the remittance is applied at exactly the charges due; the excess is returned by finance and never booked.
